metadata.title: fix: Enable CORS preflight for /servers/{id}/mcp endpoints
metadata.author: bradmcnew

description:
# 🐛 Bug-fix PR

## 📌 Summary
Browser-based MCP clients cannot connect to the gateway due to CORS preflight failures on `/servers/{id}/mcp` endpoints. The preflight OPTIONS request was being blocked by auth and not reaching CORSMiddleware.

## 🔁 Reproduction Steps
Fixes #2152
Closes #2160

1. Start gateway with browser-accessible origins configured
2. Open browser-based MCP client (e.g., mcp-use inspector at localhost:3000)
3. Attempt to connect to `http://localhost:4444/servers/{id}/mcp`
4. Browser sends CORS preflight (OPTIONS + Origin + Access-Control-Request-Method)
5. Request fails - no CORS headers returned

## 🐞 Root Cause
Two issues:
1. `streamable_http_auth` required auth for all requests including OPTIONS preflight (which cannot carry Authorization headers)
2. `MCPPathRewriteMiddleware` called handler directly, bypassing CORSMiddleware

## 💡 Fix Description
1. Detect CORS preflight in `streamable_http_auth` and allow through without auth
2. Route `/mcp` paths through `self.application` instead of calling handler directly, letting CORSMiddleware intercept preflight

This follows Starlette best practices - CORSMiddleware handles preflight rather than hand-rolling CORS responses.

## 🧪 Verification

| Check | Command | Status |
|-------|---------|--------|
| Lint suite | `ruff check` | ✅ |
| Unit tests | `pytest tests/unit/` | ✅ 65 pass |
| Security tests | `pytest tests/security/test_security_headers.py` | ✅ 20 pass |
| Doctests | `python -m doctest` | ✅ 180 pass |
| Manual test | Browser inspector connects to gateway | ✅ |

## 📐 MCP Compliance
- [x] Matches current MCP spec (no protocol changes)
- [x] No breaking change to MCP clients

## ✅ Checklist
- [x] Code formatted
- [x] No secrets/credentials committed
- [x] Added integration test for preflight (`test_cors_preflight_on_mcp_endpoints`)

Signed-off-by: Brad McNew <mcnewbrad@gmail.com>

commits.message:
fix: Enable CORS preflight for /servers/{id}/mcp endpoints (#2152)

Allow browser-based MCP clients to connect by:
- Bypassing auth for CORS preflight (OPTIONS + Origin + Access-Control-Request-Method)
- Routing /mcp paths through middleware stack so CORSMiddleware handles preflight

Closes #2152

commits.message:
fix: Address review findings for CORS preflight PR

- Add SSE-aware compression middleware to skip compression for /mcp
  paths when json_response_enabled=False (SSE mode). This prevents
  buffering/breaking of streaming responses while still compressing
  JSON responses in the default mode.
- Fix CORS test to properly validate against actual CORSMiddleware
  config instead of patching settings after app startup. Add test
  for disallowed origin rejection.
- Update MCPPathRewriteMiddleware docstring to reflect actual behavior
  (rewrites to /mcp/ with trailing slash, not /mcp).

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
fix: Prevent double token scoping for /mcp requests

Use request.state flag to track if scoping has already been done.
This is more robust than checking modified_path because:
- request.state persists across all middleware invocations
- The flag is set before any scoping work is done

The previous approach using modified_path didn't work because
the scope["modified_path"] check couldn't reliably detect the
second pass through the middleware stack.

Closes #2160

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
